title: Do MLLMs Exhibit Human-like Perceptual Behaviors? HVSBench: A Benchmark for MLLM Alignment with Human Perceptual Behavior
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in terms of their alignment with the human visual system (HVS), including tasks like saliency prediction and scanpath analysis. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
